bools.comment: the combos prose (capture p. 16): a number is the racial level cap - the class belongs but rises no higher

bools.comment: the combos prose (capture p. 16): a wish spell allows one level above the racial maximum

bools.comment: the combos prose (capture p. 16): the alignment restrictions apply to members of all races

banner.title: CLASS AND RACE COMBINATIONS, printed capture pp. 16-23 - the OA Chapter 2 opener round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 16-23 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). ENCODINGS: Table 9 U pins as the sentinel 99 and No as 0; Table 13 is a TEXT-HEAVY grid encoded as tiers - the armor tiers (any/leather-class/none), the weapon modes (any/any-but/named) with the list-count column carrying the printed weapon lists as counts (shukenja 16, the sohei 7-item exclusion list, wu jen 20, monk 16), the oil and poison tiers. The Table 12 colon notation pins as two columns - the required minimum and the 10-percent bonus minimum; the barbarian Wisdom 16 prints as the only MAXIMUM on a minimum table and pins as its own bool. The Table 13 riders (the samurai-kensai ninja-weapon honor loss, the samurai siege-oil exception, the ninja proficiency requirement) pin as bools.
